evidence: 21 November 2026: inspected fresh 1440×1000 and 390×1000 offline reader screenshots and all 13 primary figures, including labels, branches and clipping. Five-section navigation (case brief, design walkthrough, technical deep dives, practice, quick review), in-section rail, reading column and progress rail keep the existing layout at 1440px; at 390px the section tabs wrap to two rows, the topic selector replaces the rail and title, summary and body text wrap inside the viewport with no horizontal overflow or cut-off. Figures render cleanly: The core idea, stakeholder fan-out, discovery pass, six questions, control/data-plane architecture, seven-step release path, loop drill, loop failure overlay, four-phase rollout, exception decision tree, idempotency sequence, publish order and pacing timeline each match their alt text. limits: Protected source diagrams colour terminal or failure nodes dark red with purple, green or dark text, so those labels read at low contrast; the source images cannot be changed.
Some protected source labels break mid-word inside narrow boxes ('max-hop/max-rev isit', 'authorize-by-polic y', 'validateAdapterM appings').
Sequence-diagram message labels are small at reading width and are easier to read from the full-size figure. The rollout strip is wide with small text.

Dark variants were not individually inspected; their source bytes are preserved. A screen reader review was not performed. Only the first screen of each UI capture (1000px tall) was inspected, not every section of the reader.
